title: A new service is exposed by adding one file
description: Four services are routed; a fifth (tracking) is declared in the topology but has no route. One file, input/new/tracking.yaml, is added under routes/.
pass_criterion: The table is accepted before and after; the diff is exactly 1 entry added, 0 removed, 0 changed; every pre-existing file is byte-identical; the new public host resolves to tracking:3000 and is not served on the admin entrypoint.
lesson: Exposing a service is one reviewable file; the diff of the route table is the review.
